data.title: A report exports as its own page, not as a section of the board export
data.why: A report is a question with a window: --since 90d is half its meaning. The board export is a snapshot with no window, so a Reports section inside it could only ever show one arbitrary window, and the 2026-09-10 design note that proposed it did not notice that. A page per report also keeps 'kadence report' the single catalogue an agent can discover, and keeps the board file about the board.
data.rejected: A Reports section inside board export --html and --md, as docs/research/reports-discovery-2026-09.md planned; a separate 'kadence export' verb, which would have broken the documented 'board export'
